title.zh: 【Base 完成 Cobalt 升级，新增条件交易并扩展了 B20 资产功能】
title.en: 【Base 完成 Cobalt 升级，新增条件交易并扩展了 B20 资产功能】

current_state.zh: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.
current_state.en: Base completed its third mainnet upgrade, Cobalt, adding condition-gated Validity Transactions and three new B20 token-standard features, with a roadmap toward 200ms block times, native smart accounts, and gas sponsorship.
